claims: American Idol features judges Carrie Underwood, Luke Bryan, and Lionel Richie for the 2026 season.
Ryan Seacrest is returning as host for American Idol's 2026 season.
Carrie Underwood joined the American Idol panel in 2025.
Carrie Underwood replaced Katy Perry on the American Idol panel.
Simon Cowell, Paula Abdul, and Randy Jackson were original judges on American Idol.
Luke Bryan joined American Idol in 2018 (Season 16).
Lionel Richie joined American Idol in 2018 (Season 16).
Katy Perry was a panelist on American Idol from 2018 to 2024.
American Idol moved from Fox to ABC in 2018.
Ryan Seacrest has been the host for the duration of the American Idol series.
Brian Dunkleman co-hosted the first season of American Idol.
American Idol's 2026 season began with Top 20 performances in Hawaii.
